opening.argument: The video presents a guide to purported Solana token rewards, not evidence of a completed wallet transaction. Its narration describes a site that calculates a wallet reward from network activity, while the displayed page shows recovered-SOL and rebate totals beside an amount to claim. A separate sale view shows SOL-to-USDC fields, and a wallet-selection modal appears over the claim page. Those screens show an invitation to connect, but no completed connection, permissions request, asset transfer, or transaction outcome. The destination is transcribed inconsistently, and no off-page result is verified. On this record, the promotional material does not establish deceptive conduct or losses.

citations.quote: The site checks your activity on the network and uses its algorithms to calculate the amount you'll receive in your wallet visit fulldrop.com.
